meta.walk_forward: tau multiplier tuned on 2019-2023 (fit before 2019); held-out 2024-01-01 on (fit before 2024, frozen); final tables fit on all data

comparisons.note: negative = better for log losses; positive = better for card log-likelihood

round_judges_home_vs_league.note: per judge-round; bootstrap resamples whole events

league.era_t: t = (year - 2017) / 10; group weight x exp(w_group * t)

se.note: Laplace (inverse Hessian of the MAP objective over the global block, judge effects held at their MAP values)

power_friendly.definition: logit P(judge gives the round to the fighter with +1 KD and +3 head strikes over one with a takedown and 2.5 min control) minus the league judge's; judges with 30+ cards since 2022

variants.lh_fight: fight-level shared judge noise (all rounds, all judges)

ten_eight_forecast.rule: cy[T+h] = cy[T] + damp * h * (cy[T] - cy[T-k]) / k; T = last training year

kd_finish.definition: P(the knockdown scorer finishes by KO/TKO in the same round | fighter-round with >= 1 KD)

kd_single.definition: P(the finishing blow is a single strike, i.e. stopped on the knockdown blow | KD-round KO finish) - proxy for a quick stoppage (no follow-up flurry)

kd_follow.definition: ground strikes landed by the finisher in the KD-round KO finish (Poisson multiplier) - proxy for the time from knockdown to stoppage

stand_tko.definition: standing TKO without a knockdown: hazard per landed standing (distance + clinch) sig strike, rounds where the striker scored no KD

gnp_tko.definition: ground-and-pound stoppage without a knockdown: hazard per landed ground sig strike

any_ko.definition: P(fight ends by KO/TKO from strikes) per fight, controls for division/era/format (overall index)

engine.judge_equation: V = b_head*dHead + b_body*dBody + b_leg*dLeg (landed, A - B); K = b_kd*dKD; G = b_td*dTD + b_ctrl_min*dCtrlMin + b_sub*dSubAtt + b_rev*dRev; t = (year - 2017)/10; z = exp(n)*(exp(v+wV*t)*V + exp(p+wK*t)*K + exp(g+wG*t)*G + h*home + u) + Logistic(0,1); u ~ N(0, s^2) per round, shared by the panel, s = sigma_shared*exp(-kappa*|core0|), core0 = exp(wV*t)*V + exp(wK*t)*K + exp(wG*t)*G; A wins the round if z > 0; winner W gets 10-8 with P = sigmoid(c0 + c_year + c + thV*V_W + thK*K_W + thG*G_W + thU*u_W) (V_W, K_W, G_W, u_W = W's edge; c_year = ten_eight.c_2026 for new fights); 10-10 with P = p_10_10 (checked before the winner); home = [A from event country] - [B]

ten_eight.c_2026_note: last level (c_now): the damped-trend forecast (damp=0.75, k=1, tuned on 2022-23) lost to it on 2024-25 (card ll -0.0033 per fight), so it is not used

engine.kappa_note: shared-noise sd per round = sigma_shared * exp(-kappa * |core0|), core0 = exp(wV*t)*V + exp(wK*t)*K + exp(wG*t)*G (league weights, no home term); kappa < 0: lopsided rounds carry more shared noise (heavier tails than logistic-normal)
engine.pool_note: draw three distinct judges by share; '_other' = a judge not in the table: draw (n, v, p, g, c) ~ N(0, unknown_judge_sd^2)
engine.referee_note: multipliers on the league rate (odds for kd_finish, kd_single, doctor, dq, deduction; rate for kd_follow, stand_tko, gnp_tko); default = empirical-Bayes shrinkage (referees_eb); referees_tuned = less shrinkage (2019-2023 tuned tau), a style knob that did not improve 2024-2025 predictions

panel_sharpness_shift.note: added to every judge's n (all judges more decisive). 2025 judges agreed more than any earlier year (round unanimity 0.808 vs 0.76-0.80 before; split/majority decisions 15.3% vs 18-27%); nothing before 2025 predicts it, so the default stays 0

fight_level_judge_noise_sd.note: one N(0, sd^2) draw per fight added to every round's shared noise; improved 2022-23 but not 2024-25 (section 3.2 of research/model_officials.md), so it is off by default

home_effect.note: multiplier on h (0 turns the home-country effect off)

referee_table.note: referees_tuned (less shrinkage) did not improve 2024-25 overall; style knob only
